human_request: 两个真实模型用以往当时数据各自判断、商量、共同决策后揭晓结果
sample_rule: Each of three fixed periods: select the four signal dates with the lowest SHA256(seed:period:date). Keep the entire archived relay pool on each selected date. Order cases by a separate hash. No label, score, performance or pool-size selection.
main_event: Next adjacent official session CLOSE limit-up, using archived promotion target corroborated by unadjusted exact-cent 10% prices; missing/conflicting qualification remains UNKNOWN.
secondary_event: Next adjacent official session intraday TOUCH limit-up, separately counted.
sequence: explicit signal-only packet; dates/codes/names masked; no target or model score
each reviewer saves independent all-pool decisions before seeing other decisions
one label-hidden consultation and all-pool joint decision freeze
only then extract labels and evaluate all arms
metrics: judged-known accuracy and full-known correct fraction
precision, recall, F1, balanced accuracy, coverage
paired consultation corrections and induced errors
fixed seed 10000 day-cluster bootstrap joint-minus-each accuracy difference
abstention_policy: UNKNOWN is never a correct NO. Report judged denominator plus complete known denominator. Recall retains abstained positive labels as misses, coverage separate.
top3_policy: Rank exactly min(3,pool size) relative candidates, even if direction NO/UNKNOWN; relative rank is not a positive forecast. Top3 slots with unknown outcomes retained.
end_rule: One fixed sample, one independent pass each, one consultation. No outcome-driven date replacement, parameter adjustment, post-reveal decision change, retraining, production deployment or formal-ledger writes.
limits: Previously researched historical universe and late-acquired sources: masked replay is NOT independently certified blind or genuine forward evidence.
Historical contemporaneous theme/forum/announcement coverage is insufficient; packet tests price-volume/emotion/competition reasoning only, not a full narrative strategy.
Archived pool and bars retain original survivor and supplier scope biases. No claim of all-A-share performance.
No fill, profit or calibrated individual event probability is inferred.
